$comment: EXP-1490 (eMCP E1, epic VAPP-175, 2026-10-31): THE `mcp_calls` AUDIT, one row per MCP tool call on `/api/mcp` and `/api/mcp/apps`, written by the server after the call (never blocking it; a failed insert is logged, the call still answers). SERVER-ONLY, never a shape. Columns (`columns`): `id` uuid; `team_id` (the app's team, or the team the built-in call touched; null when none); `user_id` = the MEMBER the call acted as; `client_id` = the OAuth client (`oauth_applications.client_id`), null for a session cookie or a personal API key; `app_id` = the app whose tool ran, null for a built-in tool; `tool` = the name as the client called it (`timesheet__log`, `exponential_issues`); `status` (`statuses`, `callStatus(outcome)` = the FIRST of: `denied` (not listed for the caller, a call-time refusal: exposes.json `upstreamCallError`), `invalid` (the arguments fail the input schema), `upstream` (the upstream errored, timed out or is not callable, upstream.json), `failed` (the run's result is an error), else `ok`); `error` = a short code (exposes/upstream error codes), never a message or argument text; `latency_ms` integer (the broker's wall time, rounded down); `args_hash`; `created_at`. THE ARGS HASH (`hashCases`): `hashPrefix` + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the CANONICAL JSON of the call's arguments as received (absent = `{}`): object keys sorted by Unicode code point, recursively; no whitespace; arrays keep their order; strings escaped as JSON (`"`, `\\`, \b \f \n \r \t, other controls as lowercase \u00xx, everything else literal UTF-8); numbers as ECMAScript prints them (integers plain, -0 as 0; fixtures keep to integers and short decimals); an `undefined` member is dropped. The arguments themselves are never stored (they may hold secrets); equal calls hash equal, so repeats are visible. RETENTION: a row older than `retentionDays` days is purged by the daily sweep (`auditExpired(created_at, now)`, `retentionCases`). Owners read their team's rows in Settings › MCP › Activity; a member reads their own.
